# `profile_schema` operations

The exact fields each `profile_schema.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `profile_schema.clear`

Clear the schema: no profile is built or rebuilt for the namespace, and reads answer `no_schema`.

`POST /v1/profile_schema.clear` · MCP `loom_profile_schema_clear` · role `admin` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when the namespace has no profile schema. |
| `json_schema` | `dict[str, Any]` | The schema as stored (canonical JSON key order); {} when not found. |
| `schema_sha256` | `str` | SHA-256 of the canonical schema; each built profile names the hash it was built under. |
| `updated_by` | `str` | The subject that set it; empty when not found. |
| `updated_at` | `datetime \| None` | When it was set; None when not found. |

## `profile_schema.set`

Set the namespace's profile schema.

`POST /v1/profile_schema.set` · MCP `loom_profile_schema_set` · role `admin` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `json_schema` | `dict[str, Any]` | required | A JSON Schema object: `properties` (1-64), each with a `type` (string, number, integer, boolean, or array with `items`) and a `description` the profile builder reads; at most 16 KiB. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when the namespace has no profile schema. |
| `json_schema` | `dict[str, Any]` | The schema as stored (canonical JSON key order); {} when not found. |
| `schema_sha256` | `str` | SHA-256 of the canonical schema; each built profile names the hash it was built under. |
| `updated_by` | `str` | The subject that set it; empty when not found. |
| `updated_at` | `datetime \| None` | When it was set; None when not found. |
